title: Open Dental Appointment Weekly Wait Time Trend
dataSources: Open Dental appointments (`opendental:appointment`), Zocdoc bookings (`zocdoc:booking`), vision prescriptions (`vision:prescription`), dental hygiene visits (`dental:hygiene`), and Withings eye-health checks (`withings:eye`).
app: Open Dental appointment exports, Zocdoc booking webhooks, vision prescription sidecars, dental hygiene visit logs, and Withings Vision eye-health readings streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=opendental:appointment wait_minutes=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(wait_minutes) as avg_duration, max(wait_minutes) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst wait time for Open Dental appointment events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture wait_minutes on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average wait time with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks whether Open Dental appointment tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
